2122004833377108018.en_summary: @tenet_research reports $NVDA approached Taiwanese political officials after prosecutors charged one of its managers in alleged AI-chip smuggling operation, Bloomberg. Nvidia disputed charges and defended employee, drawing scrutiny over handling of suspected chip diversion to China. Details: manager Chang among nine defendants facilitating sales of 130 Super Micro $SMCI servers containing 1,040 Nvidia B300 chips; 74 allegedly reached China via Indonesia and Japan, 56 seized by Taiwan Coast Guard in May. Alleged concealed transactions, forgery, breach-of-trust charges max 5 years.
2122004833377108018.zh_summary: @tenet_research 報告 $NVDA 在檢察官指控其一名經理涉嫌 AI 晶片走私行動後接觸台灣政治官員，據 Bloomberg。Nvidia 否認指控並為員工辯護，引發對其處理疑似晶片轉運至中國的審查。詳情：經理 Chang 為九名被告之一，促進銷售 130 台 Super Micro $SMCI 伺服器含 1,040 個 Nvidia B300 晶片；74 個據稱經印尼及日本到達中國，56 個於 5 月被台灣海巡署扣押。涉嫌隱藏交易、偽造、背信罪最高 5 年。
